collection.title: Renault Clio Hatchback 2026 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Clio 2026 Onwards model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 12" for the passengers side. This model uses the Renault Specific arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
